title: Sandbox judge: apply, test, lint, size
spec: Add src/judge/sandbox.ts: judgePatch({ repoDir, unit, patch, exec, clock }) → Verdict. Steps, each a reason on failure: refuse paths outside unit.files or under .github/, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, vendor/, test/ (public tests are not patchable); git apply --3way --check then apply; run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (coverage json-summary read back for the lines %); count changed lines with git diff --numstat (≤ unit.max_lines). exec is injected ({ cmd, args, cwd, timeoutMs }) → { code, stdout, stderr }) so the unit test never spawns. Wall clock cap 15 min. Nothing here touches the network or reads keys.
done: With a scripted exec, a good patch passes with coverage and changed_lines filled and each bad patch fails with the matching reason.
